items.source: the EntityManagerFactory to use
items.translation: 要使用的 EntityManagerFactory

items.source: This filter makes JPA EntityManagers available via the current thread, which will be autodetected by transaction managers. It is suitable for service layer transactions via JpaTransactionManager or JtaTransactionManager as well as for non-transactional read-only execution.
items.translation: 此过滤器通过当前线程提供 JPA EntityManagers，事务管理器将自动检测它们。它适用于通过 JpaTransactionManager 或 JtaTransactionManager 的服务层事务，也适用于非事务性只读执行。

items.source: Looks up the EntityManagerFactory in Spring's root web application context. Supports an "entityManagerFactoryBeanName" filter init-param in web.xml; the default bean name is "entityManagerFactory". As an alternative, the "persistenceUnitName" init-param allows for retrieval by logical unit name (as specified in persistence.xml).
items.translation: 在 Spring 的根 Web 应用程序上下文中查找 EntityManagerFactory。支持 `web.xml` 中的 "entityManagerFactoryBeanName" filter init-param；默认 bean 名称为 "entityManagerFactory"。作为替代方案，"persistenceUnitName" init-param 允许通过逻辑单元名称（如 `persistence.xml` 中指定）进行检索。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to the lookupEntityManagerFactory without arguments, caching the EntityManagerFactory reference once obtained.
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给不带参数的lookupEntityManagerFactory，并在获取到 EntityManagerFactory 引用后将其缓存。

items.source:
Default is "entityManagerFactory". Note that this default only applies
when no "persistenceUnitName" param has been specified.
items.translation: 默认值为 "entityManagerFactory"。请注意，此默认值仅在未指定 "persistenceUnitName" 参数时适用。

items.source:
This is an alternative to specifying the EntityManagerFactory by bean name,
resolving it by its persistence unit name instead. If no bean name and no persistence
unit name have been specified, we'll check whether a bean exists for the default
bean name "entityManagerFactory"; if not, a default EntityManagerFactory will
be retrieved through finding a single unique bean of type EntityManagerFactory.
items.translation: 这是通过持久化单元名称解析而非通过 Bean 名称指定 EntityManagerFactory 的替代方案。如果未指定 Bean 名称和持久化单元名称，我们将检查是否存在名为"entityManagerFactory"的默认 Bean；如果不存在，则将通过查找唯一的 EntityManagerFactory 类型 Bean 来获取默认的 EntityManagerFactory。

items.source:
The default implementation looks for a bean with the specified name
in Spring's root application context.
items.translation: 默认实现会在 Spring 的根应用程序上下文中查找指定名称的 Bean。

items.source: Description copied from class: OncePerRequestFilter
items.translation: 描述从类复制：OncePerRequestFilter

items.source: Returns "false" so that the filter may re-bind the opened EntityManager to each asynchronously dispatched thread and postpone closing it until the very last asynchronous dispatch.
items.translation: 返回 "false"，以便过滤器可以将打开的 `EntityManager` 重新绑定到每个异步分发的线程，并将其关闭推迟到最后一个异步分发时。

items.source: Returns "false" so that the filter may provide an EntityManager to each error dispatches.
items.translation: 返回 "false"，以便过滤器能够为每个错误分派提供 `EntityManager`。

items.source:
Return the bean name of the EntityManagerFactory to fetch from Spring's
root application context.
items.translation: 返回 EntityManagerFactory 的 Bean 名称，以便从 Spring 的根应用程序上下文中获取。

items.source: Return the name of the persistence unit to access the EntityManagerFactory for, if any.
items.translation: 返回要访问 EntityManagerFactory 的持久化单元名称（如果有）。

items.source:
Default EntityManagerFactory bean name: "entityManagerFactory".
Only applies when no "persistenceUnitName" param has been specified.
items.translation:
默认 EntityManagerFactory 的 Bean 名称为："entityManagerFactory"。
仅在未指定"persistenceUnitName"参数时适用。

items.source: Same contract as for doFilter, but guaranteed to be just invoked once per request within a single request thread.
items.translation: 与doFilter相同的合同，但保证在单个请求线程中每个请求仅被调用一次。
